topic: App Store & Google Play launch checklist: 5 things before you submit
caption:
Your app is built. Now the stores have to say yes. 📲

5 things to sort out before you submit to the App Store and Google Play:

1️⃣ Developer accounts set up early
2️⃣ Privacy policy and data disclosures
3️⃣ Store listing: icon, screenshots, description
4️⃣ A demo login for reviewers
5️⃣ Buffer time for review and fixes

Miss one and your launch date slips. Swipe for what to check in each. →

Getting ready to ship? DM us STORE and we'll walk through this list with you.

Save this for launch week. 🔖

slides.title: Before you submit to the app stores.
slides.sub: 5 things that keep launch on track. Swipe →

slides.title: Set up developer accounts early.
slides.body: Apple and Google both verify new developer accounts, and that can take time. Start this weeks before launch, not on launch day.

slides.title: Privacy policy and data disclosures.
slides.body: Both stores ask for a privacy policy link and details on what data your app collects. Have them ready before you submit.

slides.title: A store listing that sells.
slides.body: Icon, screenshots, a clear description and the right category. This is your app's shop window.

slides.title: A demo login for reviewers.
slides.body: If your app needs an account, give reviewers a working test login. Without one, review can stall or fail.

slides.title: Leave buffer for review.
slides.body: Reviews take time and can come back with requests for changes. Don't announce a date that leaves no room for fixes.

slides.title: Ship to the stores without surprises.
slides.sub: Tell us where you are and we'll walk through this list with you.
